newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: PRESS DIGEST - Ireland - November 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ireland - November 26.

text.p: Following are the highlights of stories reported in the Irish press on Tuesday.
- A leader of the country's biggest police organisation said on Monday he had "grave doubts" whether Ireland's embattled Justice Minister Nora Owen was up to the job.
- SDLP leader John Hume is reported to have received a reply from British Prime Minister John Major to his suggested terms for a new IRA ceasefire.
- Unionist party leader David Trimble claimed on Monday that speculation about a new IRA ceasefire was "casting a shadow" over the Northern Ireland peace talks.
- Revenue commissioners on Monday announced a new drive against tax evaders.
